summary: Iteration 9: Re-verified HUD alignment fix + intense glow after session-preserved xp bump. (1) HUD ALIGNMENT — VISUAL PASS. Restored the SAME session (token re-injected into localStorage, /auth/me returned user HudGlow26 at level 6/3000 xp after Mongo bump), joined a match, reached active phase. On-screen the elimination-feed card and the KILLS card bottom-line up on the same horizontal edge (both visibly ending at the same y in the 390x844 viewport screenshot); the fix (removing the fixed height:150 from styles.feedCard, letting align-items:stretch pull it to match the right stat column) is effective. Numerical getBoundingClientRect probe intermittently returned null because DOM re-mounts on phase transitions; the visual screenshot is the authoritative evidence and clearly shows both cards flush at the same bottom y. (2) INTENSE GLOW — PASS. With button_fx=glow equipped on the same L6 session, the panic-button in active phase clearly shows a strong pulsing halo: a bright orange rim ring hugging the 208px button edge PLUS a large outward color bleed extending well beyond the button (visible in /tmp screenshots). This matches the 'bright rim + large outward bleed, not flat faint ring' spec. Code review confirms GlowAura renders 5 concentric GlowDisc layers with f up to 1.85 (=385px disc for a 208px button) + a GlowRim with borderWidth:5, colored shadow (shadowColor #FF9500, shadowOpacity 0.9, shadowRadius 22, elevation 18) scaling 0.98→1.07 pulsing on a 1350ms cycle. (3) FIRE — PASS (visual). After equipping button_fx=fire and re-entering a match, warm flame tongues render around the button edge; DOM probe counted 4 small warm-tone Views near the button center in one snapshot (flames animate through opacity so a single frame captures only a subset; total FIRE_COUNT=20). No crashes. (4) PRESS BURST — PASS. Tapping the panic-button in the active glow session produced the ring+sparks burst; the button remained visible/tappable afterwards and no red-screen / 'Something went wrong' banner appeared. Second visible-danger screenshot at 9% confirms sparks radiating from button edge. (5) BOTTOM BUTTONS — PASS. find-match-btn fully visible on main menu with the L6 profile card; lobby-cancel (LEAVE LOBBY) fully visible on lobby screen; return-lobby-btn code path unchanged from iter8. (6) FAILSAFE EQUIP — PASS. On L6 user, POST /api/profile/ability {ability_id:'failsafe'} succeeded (unlock_level=3 <= 6). Session-preservation methodology worked: login once via UI, capture JWT from localStorage['panic_auth_token'], bump xp/level directly in Mongo for the SAME user, then re-inject the token in a fresh browser context and navigate to '/' so index.tsx reads the stored token and routes into /(tabs) with the newly-leveled user. (Note: reloading directly on /auth is stuck — auth screen doesn't auto-redirect when user context becomes truthy; use goto('/') instead. Reported as minor UX below.) Residual (unchanged): (a) 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning from match/[id].tsx:311 reveal Animated.View, (b) IBM Plex TTF fonts fail to decode via the web preview proxy (OTS invalid sfntVersion) — web-only, native builds unaffected.

issues: IBM Plex TTF fonts still fail to decode via the preview proxy (OTS invalid sfntVersion). Falls back to system font on web only. Long-standing, native unaffected.

auth.tsx does not auto-redirect to /(tabs) when the AuthContext user becomes truthy — if the app reloads while the URL is /auth (e.g. after a page refresh from that route), the user stays on the login screen even though a valid token+session are restored. Low priority (does not affect the fresh-visit or root '/' flow), but worth adding a `useEffect` in auth.tsx that calls router.replace('/(tabs)') when `user` transitions to non-null. Reference: /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx (no such effect exists).

critical_code_review_comments: styles.feedCard now correctly declares only `flex: 1.4` with NO fixed height, so align-items:stretch on the hudRow pulls it to match the right stat column's height (2 * statCard @ flex:1 + gap = intrinsic height). This resolves the iter8 alignment regression (delta was 38px). Verified visually in-browser.

fx.tsx GlowAura: 5 layered GlowDisc(f=1.85→1.02) + GlowRim (borderWidth:5, colored shadow, elevation:18) pulsing on 1350ms cycle — produces the intense-bleed + bright-rim effect requested. Confirmed in-browser screenshots.

match/[id].tsx onPanic increments burstKey BEFORE calling api.press so <PressBurst key={burstKey}/> remounts and replays for every tap. Verified live: repeated taps produced repeated bursts with no crash.

Direct reload on /auth does NOT redirect on session restoration (see design_issues).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: https://button-royale-pvp.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Auth: name-only guest at /auth/guest. To session-preserve a bumped-xp user in an automation session: (1) UI-login with a fresh callsign, (2) read localStorage.getItem('panic_auth_token') (JSON-encoded quoted string), (3) `python /tmp/bump_user_xp.py <username>` to set xp=3000/level=6 in test_database.users, (4) in a NEW browser context: navigate to origin, localStorage.setItem('panic_auth_token', JSON.stringify(TOKEN)), (5) equip cosmetics/ability via fetch('/api/profile/cosmetic' or '/api/profile/ability'), (6) page.goto('/') — index.tsx will route to /(tabs) with the restored user. Do NOT page.reload() while on /auth — auth.tsx does not auto-redirect on session restoration. To measure HUD alignment reliably, wait_for_selector('[data-testid="danger-pct"]') to confirm active phase, but note the DOM re-mounts on phase transitions so grab metrics within ~1s of phase entry.
rca_of_issue: HUD ALIGNMENT FIX VERIFICATION: iter8 report ID'd `height: 150` on styles.feedCard as the ROOT CAUSE of the 38px delta between feedCard.bottom and killCard.bottom. iter9 confirms: /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx:711 now reads `feedCard: { flex: 1.4 }` with NO explicit height. Coupled with `statCard: { flex: 1 }` inside `statsCol: { flex: 1, gap: space.sm }` on a row with default align-items:stretch, both columns naturally match heights. Visually the two card bottoms are flush in the in-browser active-match screenshot. No further action needed on this fix.
